summary: Rate C$55+GST confirmed and now dated (pricing page modified 2026-09-21); sites 32->36; hookups 30/W/S confirmed; year_round true added; phone booking with 3-night long-weekend minimum; long-stay character and Google 3.7 flagged.
flags: Google Maps 3.7 stars from 20 reviews (under the 25-review line, so not the under-4.0 rule on its own), phone 403-749-2099 (matches), website fawnmeadowslodge.com (loads in a browser; curl gets 403). Google lists it as 'Fawn Meadows Lodge, Cabins & Year Round RV Park'.

Long-stay character (report with the rating): pricing page markets 'RV Seasonals $3,050.00 + gst', 'RV MONTHLY RATE (summer) $1250.00', 'RV WINTER RATE $800 + gst + power'; about page 'year round RV sites available'. Nightly C$55 is posted and nights are sold by phone; no engine, so the nightly share (test 3) could not be measured. Imagery shows about 40 units in rows by the lodge plus a treed area to the south full of RVs. Reviewer: under 4 stars plus borderline seasonal is the auto-drop combination - the rating is under 25 reviews, the seasonal share is unmeasured.

Price: C$55 + 5% GST, under C$69; no gateway within 40 km (gateways.py: nearest Calgary 141 km). Site page still shows 'Copyright (c) 2020' and an 'OPENING FOR 2020 SEASON' news item; the pricing page itself was modified 2026-09-21.
Pin 52.20088,-113.22696 sits on the RV rows north of the lodge; Google 52.2006424,-113.2273723 (~35 m) - confirmed.
